about: The catalog: the parts here, one file per app in catalog/entries/<id>-<name>.json. Edit these, then run node scripts/build.mjs, which writes the merged catalog.json at the project root (generated; do not edit it). status: planned | built. A built app has js/apps/<name>.js and pages/<part slug>/<name>.qmd.

parts.title: Ranking under uncertainty
parts.lead: Estimates are noisy, so a league table of them is partly noise. A posterior says how sure we are of each unit and of each direction between two units.

parts.title: From ranks to grades
parts.lead: A grade report states the direction of every pair in different grades and stays silent on pairs in the same grade. Its risk adds the expected wrong directions and a price τ for each silent pair.

parts.title: Common rules
parts.lead: Tiers, flags and posterior cuts are grade reports too. Read as reports, they can be compared with the frontier at the same disclosure. Other questions, such as stability or filling a fixed number of places, need their own yardsticks.

parts.title: Multiple criteria
parts.lead: One common grade column can be assessed across criteria, or separate domain columns can retain a profile. Compare their report spaces, decisions and protection.

parts.title: Multidomain profiles
parts.lead: Separate ordered grades retain each domain in a profile. Additive risk can separate across domains, while joint protection can change which complete profile card is optimal.

parts.title: Cases
parts.lead: KRW's loss and its λ set against postrank's τ, then released case data read as postrank reports: firms in the KRW discrimination report card, California schools and Alabama counties.

parts.title: Tools
parts.lead: Your own posterior summaries in the browser, and a released case graded with your settings, with what the report states and leaves unsaid.
